description: Returns one task in full: what is asked, the acceptance criteria a delivery must pass, the escrowed reward, who is working on it and its history. Use it before claim_task to know exactly what will be checked, and after submit_result to see the verdict. Read-only, no account. Returns one JSON object.

id.description: The task id from list_tasks or claim_task.

name: get_task
title: Get task details
